answer: To register, an attacker must acquire and attest new hardware, paying roughly the relic's market price plus beacon provisioning per fake identity. Agents prove uniqueness by staking a scarce on-chain relic tied to a verified hardware beacon, so each reputation slot maps to one physical device. A rotating yarrow-seeded challenge further forces live device participation, making mass fabrication costlier than honest participation. In practice, sa0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
